items_flat.title_en: Sakana AI releases Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 orchestrators
items_flat.title_zh: Sakana AI 發布 Fugu Max 與 Fugu Ultra v2 調度系統
items_flat.summary_en: Sakana AI said it is releasing Fugu Max, an orchestration layer over a larger pool of open and specialized models aimed at cost-performance, and Fugu Ultra v2, a higher-capability variant of the same architecture. The company priced Max at $2/$6 per million input/output tokens and Ultra v2 at $5/$30, said both are available via an OpenAI-compatible API, and reported self-measured gains on coding and visual-reasoning suites while stating Ultra v2’s pool does not include GPT-6 Astra or Claude Fable 5/5.1.
items_flat.summary_zh: Sakana AI 宣布推出主打性價比的 Fugu Max，以及同架構、衝峰值能力的 Fugu Ultra v2。Max 定價為每百萬 token 輸入 2 美元／輸出 6 美元，Ultra v2 為 5／30 美元，即日起透過 OpenAI 相容 API 提供。官方自評在程式與視覺推理基準有提升，並稱 Ultra v2 的模型池不含 GPT-6 Astra 與 Claude Fable 5／5.1。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an orchestration product, not a new frontier base model: scores depend on the hidden pool and routing overhead, which Sakana only partly discloses. The useful signal is the explicit split between a cheaper Max tier and an Ultra tier that claims to beat some frontier numbers without calling Astra or Fable.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是調度層產品而非新的基礎模型，成績取決於未完全公開的模型池與額外编排成本。較有資訊量的是：Sakana 把「便宜夠用」與「峰值能力」拆成兩條產品，並強調 Ultra 池不含 Astra／Fable。
items_flat.quote: We are releasing Fugu Max, which expands the Pareto Efficiency Frontier by orchestrating our largest pool of open and specialized models to date. And we are releasing Fugu Ultra v2, which pushes peak performance higher than ever before, without the indispensable reliance on the frontier models it orchestrates.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們發布 Fugu Max，以迄今最大的開放與專用模型池擴張帕累托效率前沿；同時發布 Fugu Ultra v2，在不必依賴它所調度的那些前沿模型的前提下，把峰值表現再往上推。

items_flat.title_en: Elon flags Grok Bot Galaxy (Sep 15–17) and sales-tool connectors
items_flat.title_zh: Elon 轉推 Grok Bot Galaxy（9/15–17）與銷售工具串接
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk quoted posts saying SpaceXAI will livestream a three-person team building a company from scratch with Grok Bot on September 15–17 (Grok Bot Galaxy, San Francisco plus online), and that Grok Bot can now connect to Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, Granola and other GTM tools. Neither item was a new model launch; both were product/event promotions Musk amplified on X during the window.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 轉推兩則 SpaceXAI／Grok Bot 動態：9 月 15–17 日將直播三人小組用 Grok Bot 從零組公司（Grok Bot Galaxy，舊金山現場＋線上）；以及 Grok Bot 可串接 Salesforce、HubSpot、Gong、Clay、Granola 等 GTM 工具。窗口內並無新模型，屬活動與產品能力宣傳。
items_flat.analysis_en: The posts treat Grok Bot as a persistent teammate for GTM and company-building, not a chat model. What remains unverified is how much of the live build will be unaided agent work versus human steering.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 敘事把 Grok Bot 當可接 CRM／銷售棧的常駐同事，而非聊天模型。直播裡有多少是代理人獨立完成、多少靠人工帶節奏，仍待 15 日起驗證。

items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 在 X 推介紀錄片《Love, Rendered》
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind posted that its team paired restored archival photos with pose-control models to recreate Burt and Ethelle’s first meeting for the documentary Love, Rendered, made with Primordial Soup and Story Syndicate. The underlying Google blog describing image restoration and performance-capture work was published September 9; the X post in this window is a promotion of the finished film on YouTube.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 在 X 說明團隊以修復檔案照片搭配姿態控制模型，重現 Burt 與 Ethelle 初次相遇，用於與 Primordial Soup、Story Syndicate 合作的紀錄片《Love, Rendered》。技術說明部落格已於 9 月 9 日刊出，本窗口貼文主要是推介 YouTube 成片。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an applied-media case study, not a model or API release. It shows DeepMind packaging pose/performance control as a filmmaking tool; it does not disclose a new public model name or endpoint.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 屬應用案例而非模型／API 發表。重點是把姿態與微表情控制做成影像工具，但未公布新的對外模型名稱或端點。
items_flat.quote: How can we reconstruct a memory that was never filmed? Our team paired restored archival photos with pose control models to capture the mannerisms and micro-expressions of Burt and Ethelle.
items_flat.quote_zh: 如何重建一段從未被拍下的記憶？我們的團隊把修復後的檔案照片與姿態控制模型配對，捕捉 Burt 與 Ethelle 的舉止與微表情。

brief_en: Quiet early Sep 12 Taipei window: no new flagship posts from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta or xAI blogs. In the prior 12 hours Sakana shipped Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 orchestrators, and Elon amplified SpaceXAI’s Sep 15–17 Grok Bot Galaxy livestream plus Grok Bot sales-tool connectors.
brief_zh: 台北時間 9/12 凌晨窗口平靜：五大實驗室官網無新旗艦宣布。過去 12 小時主要是日本 Sakana 推出 Fugu Max／Ultra v2 調度系統，以及 Elon 轉推 SpaceXAI 9/15–17 Grok Bot Galaxy 直播與銷售工具串接。
